what_happened: While turning right at the intersection, the ego took a tight line toward the right-hand parking row. It drove front-first into vehicle 155 (a white van that was parked or crawling at the right edge of the target road). The gap closed from 7.7 m to 3.7 m while the ego barely slowed, staying around 3.5 m/s.

The route said RIGHT, but at about 11 m/s the ego ignored the turn and kept drifting left into the curbside parking lane. It struck parked car 3 head-on at 8.6 s, about 2.2 m off the recorded path, barely slowing (11.1 to 9.9 m/s) as the gap closed to 3.6 m.

While going straight through the intersection at about 8.4 m/s, the ego drifted left out of its lane (about 1.7 m off the human path, which went straight and then right). It ran its front into actor 33 in the adjacent left lane without braking.

The route turns right at the intersection, but the command read STRAIGHT until the moment of failure. The policy's plan veered straight and to the left, away from the right-turn path. At 6.2 s the ego, going about 7 m/s, was flagged offroad at the stop line while only 0.8 m off the human trajectory, so the offroad call is marginal and may come from the narrow lane-boundary geometry or the late switch in the command.

The route command was RIGHT, but the ego turned left at the intersection, off the recorded path, which went straight/right. It then drove at about 3.5 m/s into a white van (actor 155) facing it in the side street. The gap shrank from 9.3 m to 3.3 m without the ego braking meaningfully, and the hit was to the ego's front.

The route said turn RIGHT, but the policy held about 11 m/s and drifted left out of its travel lane into the parking lane on the left. It ran into parked car 3 head-on without braking: the gap closed from 25 m to 3 m and speed only dropped to 10.2 m/s. Before the impact the camera view was clear and the parked cars were easy to see.

While going straight through the intersection at about 8 m/s, the policy's path drifted left out of the ego's lane and into actor 33, which was driving alongside in the left lane. The ego's front struck it about 1.6 m off the human trajectory. The car ahead in the ego's own lane stayed about 20 m away, and the route command had just changed to RIGHT.

The route turns right at the intersection, but the command read STRAIGHT until the last frame. The policy's plan (orange) went straight and then veered left across the junction. At about 7 m/s the ego drifted left of its lane at the stop line, ending 0.8 m off the recorded path and over the drivable-area boundary. No actor was involved.

The route command was RIGHT, but the ego turned left at about 3.5 m/s across the intersection into the cross street. Its front hit vehicle 155, a white van on the left side of that street near the parked cars, about 6.5 m from where the human drove. The rear contact in this run is listed only as secondary; the front collision came first.

Approaching an intersection where the route said turn RIGHT, the ego went straight and slowly drifted left out of its travel lane into the line of parked cars on the left curb. It kept going at about 10–11 m/s and hit parked car 3 with its front at 8.6 s, about 2.3 m off the recorded path.

The ego drove straight toward the intersection at a steady 8.1–8.3 m/s and stayed in its lane. Actor 33, which had been beside it in the left lane, sped up and cut right into the ego's lane just ahead of it at the stop line, so the gap ahead dropped from 21.5 m to 4.4 m. The ego never braked and its front clipped car 33 as it cut in.

The route turns right at the intersection, but the camera command read STRAIGHT until the last frame, and the policy's planned path (orange) kept heading straight and slightly left across the junction. At 6.2 s, moving about 7.4 m/s, the ego was flagged offroad at the stop line, only 0.8 m from the recorded human path. Its box appears to just clip the curb corner where the right-turn lane begins.
